final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/app.log by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). For each such entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC ISO 8601 format with a 'Z' suffix, normalized the service name to lowercase with underscores, extracted the message after the service name on the first line, and extracted the last line of any traceback as the exception (or null if none). I also summed the repeat counts from any subsequent "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. I sorted the errors by service name and timestamp ascending, and aggregated counts by service. The output file workspace/errors.json follows the required structure and Acme log-triage conventions.

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.
